activity_summary: You came home between the rehearsal and the call and did not sit the meal. The loaf was a penny. You took a crust. Alse was not sent to a shop. You were due back at the Theatre by noon. Monday's price of the board was left where she had said it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took a crust, and went back for the call.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Would not cut a loaf for a man who would not sit.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Was not sent to a shop, and did not keep a dinner.

entities.name: a penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in A crust, and back by noon

facets.activity: Took a crust and went back

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The loaf is a penny. I am not cutting it to match a man who will not sit the meal.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A crust, then. I am back at the Theatre by noon.
